corrected_content.worked_solution: For a scalar line integral, substitute the parametrization and multiply by speed. Here $r'(t)=\langle2\sqrt t,t-1\rangle$, so $\|r'(t)\|=\sqrt{4t+(t-1)^2}=t+1$ on $[0,1]$. Also $3x=4t^{3/2}$. Thus $$\int_C3x\,ds=4\int_0^1(t^{5/2}+t^{3/2})\,dt=4\left(\frac27+\frac25\right)=\frac{96}{35}.$$
